title: Amundi Tokenizes STOXX Europe 600 Fund Share Class on Ethereum
why_it_matters: The launch moves a large asset manager's tokenized-fund work from cash-like products into broad European equity exposure while retaining the fund's existing operating model and traditional distribution route.
caption:
RWA WIRE // FUND-LAUNCH

Amundi Tokenizes STOXX Europe 600 Fund Share Class on Ethereum

Amundi launched an Ethereum-issued share class of its Core STOXX Europe 600 fund with CACEIS, extending its tokenization program from cash-management products into equity index investing.
